lines.zh: 双翼半张，我沿草坡滑行
lines.en: Wings half-spread, I skim the grassy slope.
My feathers brush the red sand of the badlands.
I hop forward; it costs less than walking.

lines.zh: 我踩着风，落在平原草尖
lines.en: I ride the wind onto the plain's grass tips.
Wings folded, I bounce with each step.

lines.zh: 恶地的热风把我推向前
lines.en: The hot badlands wind pushes me on.

lines.zh: 我绕着灌木走，不留巢痕
lines.en: I circle the shrubs so my nest leaves no trace.

lines.zh: 羽毛掉了一路，我懒得捡
lines.en: Feathers trail behind me; I don't bother picking them up.
I push off my legs and leap the stones.
I glide low over the ground for a few steps.

lines.zh: 平原的草太软，我踮着走
lines.en: The plain is too soft, so I walk on tiptoe.

lines.zh: 我扬起的尘土里夹着细羽
lines.en: Fine down drifts in the dust I kick up.
I preen my ruffled feathers by the nest.

lines.zh: 风从恶地吹来，我眯起眼
lines.en: The badlands wind blows in and I narrow my eyes.

lines.zh: 我歪头听草丛里的动静
lines.en: I tilt my head to the rustle in the grass.
My wingtips twitch once, lightly.

lines.zh: 巢里的羽毛已经够软了
lines.en: The nest's lining is soft enough now.
I curl my toes into the soil.
I stare into the distance without a sound.
Sunlight warms my feathers to a shine.
I try a short hop on the spot.

lines.zh: 天空很空，暂时没有猎物
lines.en: The sky is empty; no prey yet.
I comb the down on my chest with my beak.

lines.zh: 恶地的热气贴着我的背
lines.en: The badlands heat clings to my back.
I count my own heartbeats.

lines.zh: 石头硌脚，我换了个站姿
lines.en: The stone is sharp, so I shift my stance.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀折成两片影子
lines.en: I fold my wings into two shadows.
The plain is unnervingly quiet.
I lift my head and see you clearly.
You dare come this close to my nest.
I tilt my head at your hands and feet.
My eyes narrow; I have your face now.

lines.zh: 你身上没有羽毛，真奇怪
lines.en: No feathers on you at all. Strange.
I shift my weight onto my hind legs.
My claws scrape once through the dirt.
You stand too close, human.

lines.zh: 我侧过头，避开你的视线
lines.en: I turn my head aside, avoiding your eyes.

lines.zh: 视线对上，我不打算让路
lines.en: Our eyes meet and I will not step aside.
Slowly I spread one wing.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进我的巢里
lines.en: Your shadow falls into my nest.
I fix on your throat.
You move, and I move with you.
Ow! You sheared off a handful of feathers.
I stagger back half a step.
You actually landed that.
My cry catches in my throat.
One wing lurches crooked.
That blow costs me my balance.
Blood on red sand hides well.
I hiss and retreat toward the nest.
You've angered me, human.
I'm still standing. Don't gloat.
That little thing in your hand — give it here.
That smell turns the wind sweet.
I come closer only to eat.
Don't put it away. I saw it.
I'll land and take a single taste.
You raised the food. Clever of you.
My beak is already open.
Share a bit and I won't chase you.

lines.zh: 恶地上很少有这种味道
lines.en: The badlands rarely smell like this.
One more half step closer — may I?
Hit me and you'll be knocked back.
My wing brushed your face.
Don't shove, my nest is right behind me.
One touch and my claws come out.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，尘土飞起
lines.en: We collide and dust bursts up.
You bump my chest — back off.
You've crushed my feathers out of place.
That bump was a warning.
I sidestep, then bump you again.

lines.zh: 你太近了，撞一下算轻的
lines.en: Too close. That bump was gentle.
My feathers rise for you.
This nest is room enough for two.

lines.zh: 你听见我喉咙里的低鸣吗
lines.en: Do you hear the low trill in my throat?

lines.zh: 我把最好的羽毛递给你
lines.en: I offer you my finest feather.

lines.zh: 平原的风也在为我们叫
lines.en: The plain's wind cries out for us too.
Come closer, don't fear my claws.

lines.zh: 我们一起守着这堆枯枝
lines.en: Together we'll guard this heap of twigs.
Dusk in the badlands is short.

lines.zh: 我的翅尖蹭着你的翅尖
lines.en: My wingtip rubs against yours.
This nest will hatch new plumage.
This feather fell at the right moment.
I carry a stone to line the nest floor.
The iron nuggets gleam; I keep them.
The nest mouth needs more dry twigs.
I pick up what you dropped.
This will soften my nest.
I hook it up with one claw.
The little thing is mine now.
I tuck it into my feathers.
Whatever I find goes into the nest's cracks.
You are today's quarry.
Wings spread, I take aim.
I see you and start my run-up.
The wind tells me where you are.
The prey is within reach.
I've pinned your footsteps.
This leap is meant for you.
Don't run; my legs are faster.
You've stepped into my ground.
My claws have somewhere to land.

lines.zh: 翅膀收拢，我要跃起来了。
lines.en: Wings tucked. I'm about to leap.

lines.zh: 恶地上没有遮挡，你完了
lines.en: No cover in the badlands. You're finished.
Wings spread, my shadow covers you.

lines.zh: 你的脚步乱了，我听得见
lines.en: Your steps are uneven; I can hear it.
One step closer and I drop.
I drift with your shadow.
You retreat, I advance.

lines.zh: 翅膀让我一直咬着你不放
lines.en: My wings keep me glued to you.

lines.zh: 你抬手的空当，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the gap when you raise your arm.

lines.zh: 你举盾也没用，我跳得高
lines.en: Raise your shield; I leap over it.
I've already chosen where I land.
Each circle makes you tenser.
I don't cry out. I just get closer.
Your back is open.
The next jump lands on you.
This claw sends you into the dirt.

lines.zh: 我的爪子先到，慢也到了
lines.en: My claw arrives first, and the slowness follows.
I knock you flying, then slow your crawl.
The wind of my landing is mine.
The blow throws you back.
My weight bears down on your shoulders.
Claw marks stay on your armour.
This leap connected.
Your legs grow heavy, half a beat slow.

lines.zh: 我的爪子比你的剑先动
lines.en: My claws move before your sword.
Falling feathers come first, then me.
A new shadow crosses the plain.
I fold my wings beneath the clouds.
The badlands wind carries me in.

lines.zh: 我的巢搭好了，这里有主
lines.en: My nest is built; this place has an owner.
A fall can't kill me; the ground is too soft.
I find my footing on the grass tips.
My claws settle into the red sand.
Did someone hear those wings?
I'm here, with feathers and claws.
This plain is mine to patrol now.
I fear neither height nor landing.
The sky opens a path for me.
Eggs wait for me back in the nest.
My feathers burn and I can't beat it out.

lines.zh: 摔不疼我，可你推我撞墙
lines.en: Falls don't hurt, but you shoved me into a wall.
Water soaks my feathers and I sink.

lines.zh: 爆炸的土块砸得我发懵
lines.en: Blast debris knocks the sense out of me.
An arrow in my wing and I can't fly straight.
That spell burns into my bones.
Too hungry to leap properly.

lines.zh: 雷从头顶劈下，羽毛焦了
lines.en: Lightning strikes from above; my feathers are singed.
I fall into a blank with no wind at all.
